column1: # Resolve-workflow terminology overlay (RESOLVE-UI-PLAN RS2b). [Fork]; wording is [Resolve-style].
# Consulted before the language catalogs while Settings > General > Workflow is DaVinci Resolve
# (`i18n::set_terms`). Whole strings only, never substrings. Words only: command ids, automation ids,
# project files and the control protocol are unchanged.
#   source   the English string exactly as the code and the interface catalogs have it (every source
#            must be a key of es.tsv; a test checks that, and that {placeholders} are the same)
#   english  the Resolve wording, shown when the interface language is English
#   code=... optional wording for another interface language (es, zh-cn, ...). Languages without one
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored; malformed lines are skipped.
